name: Vinesauce ROM Corruptor
description: The exact deterministic engine from the standalone ROM Corruptor app: Add/Shift/Replace a byte value, walking the file at a configurable stride (Increment) and only actually corrupting every Nth visited byte (Frequency) — two separate knobs, not aliases of each other. Start/End of -1 means auto (just past the header / end of file). Includes NES CPU-jam protection and an independent literal text find/replace pass, each with its own on/off switch.
author: Recreated for RTCFS4A

parameters.label: Enable Byte Corruption
parameters.description: Turn off if you only want Text Find/Replace below, without also scrambling the rest of the file.

parameters.label: Corruption Mode
parameters.description: Add: adds Amount to each corrupted byte (wraps at 256). Shift: bit-rotates each corrupted byte right by Amount (negative = left). Replace: turns every byte equal to Replace From into Replace To.

parameters.label: Amount
parameters.description: Used by Add and Shift modes. Shift only meaningfully differs across -7..7 (it wraps every 8).

parameters.label: Increment
parameters.description: Stride between visited byte positions. 1 = visit every byte in range; 4 = only every 4th position, etc. This is distinct from Frequency below.

parameters.label: Corrupt Every Nth Visited Byte
parameters.description: Of the positions Increment above visits, only every Nth one actually gets corrupted. 1 = corrupt all of them.

parameters.label: Start Byte
parameters.description: -1 = auto (right after Header Size below). An explicit value here always overrides the header, even to deliberately corrupt it.

parameters.label: Header Size
parameters.description: Bytes to leave alone at the start of the file when Start Byte is -1. 16 for .nes/.fds (iNES/fwNES header), 512 for headered .smc, 0 for a headerless ROM.

parameters.label: Avoid NES CPU-Jam Opcodes
parameters.description: Skips writing a corrupted byte if it would land on one of the 6502's KIL/JAM opcodes, which otherwise freeze the game solid instead of glitching it.

parameters.label: Enable Text Find/Replace
parameters.description: Independent pass: swaps one literal text string for another anywhere in the file.

parameters.label: Find Text
parameters.description: Case-sensitive, literal text to search for (e.g. Mario).

parameters.label: Replace With
parameters.description: Should be the same length as Find Text — it's padded or truncated to match so the file's size never changes (e.g. Mario -> LUIGI, both 5 letters).
